Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chokotto-tenranzan/

Want to discover changes in nature you might miss on a regular walk? Join a guide and explore Tenranzan on this easy, short tour. Everyone welcome.

【Fee】¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for returning guests; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide and insurance)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Tsubasa Kojima (Hanno Ecotourism Citizen Guides Association, Wildlife Group)

【What to bring】Drinking water, rain gear, backpack or similar (hands-free recommended), towel, insect repellent spray
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
